name: Example Inventory System
shortDescription: A demo inventory system for RPG-style games, included to showcase the catalog.
description:
This is a placeholder product description for the Example Inventory System, one of the demo assets that ship with this website.

In a real asset, this is where you'd describe what the package does, which problems it solves and what's included. Multiple paragraphs are supported, and so are lists:

- Feature one goes here
- Feature two goes here
- Feature three goes here

The Example Inventory System also has documentation and a changelog enabled. Open them to see how those pages work.

It also has `sale: 30` set in the demo data, so you can see the automatic sale display: a discount badge, the old price struck through in red, and the reduced price. The newest changelog entry automatically provides the version and the last-updated date shown on this page.
